read:from-his-seat.verdict:
Read cold, the shape is right: it says it is AI-written and unbuilt, parts "proved" from "not yet", and names what may fail. It is not ready. In five places "proved" covers more than the theorem (P1 to P5). "Words the proofs have outgrown" is unfair to him twice: his meta-attractor and 生生 are not outgrown, they are not reached (P2, P6). Some bullets are fragments, and "fixed" can be read as "repaired" (P7). The old frame returns at the end: a count closes the page (P9), and "one model" is retired, then proposed again as "the smallest space"; say so. It is ten minutes for him, not five: cut the last paragraph to one sentence, the Boundaries row, and "Mine of this week" to two items. The ending hands him the session's work (P10).
PAGE NOT READY: P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7.

read:attack-the-picture.verdict:
AI-written (Fable). The figure is half true: ways one and two share one object, carried along a course only where the take comes to stand; way three is another; where who is there depends on the level, no boundary decides. The proposed space is a dictionary until restricted, and its headline gain is a premise moved.
PAGE NOT READY: A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, C1, D1

findings.sentence: **What goes on moves the boundary.** … There are three ways.
findings.what_is_so: Ways one and two share one object: the level H + y of a standing take. Along a course it is proved only where the take in the end stands or every take is held. Way three is another object: one stock's edge of ending by where its partner starts, defined by running the course; there nothing that takes gives. Where who is there depends on the level, the present boundary decides nothing: from seven the course is at or above it for three steps and ends; from six it goes on.
findings.evidence: RegimeMargin.lean:741 ends_iff_below `… ↔ x < H + y`; :3286 `threshold … := leading (ending …) (hi + 1)`. LineOnAStock.lean:1840 higher_ends `«不穷» … ([A], 6) ∧ ¬ «不穷» … ([A], 7)`.
findings.proposed_wording: One boundary for a take that stands; along a course, proved where the take comes to stand. Where who is there depends on the level it decides nothing: in one worked case the higher start ends. Way three is another boundary.

findings.sentence: The course is kept exactly where the level after that turn is on the kept side of the new boundary. Proved, exact.
findings.what_is_so: Exact from a start already below the old boundary, where the lower take then stays. A corrected rule set again from the share breaks it: read in time, and the line ends.
findings.evidence: TurningInTime.lean:1070 turns_in_time_iff `(kept : ∀ w x, Kept w → Kept (after w x)) … (below : x < H₁ + y₁)`; :2638 read_at_eight_ends: "Read at eight, in time, and the line still ends".
findings.proposed_wording: Add: from a start already below the old boundary, provided the lower take then stays. A corrected rule need not stay: one worked course is read in time and still ends.

findings.sentence: A course can end up on the wrong side without the level having fallen yet … Proved
findings.what_is_so: The laws conclude an unmet need, or an ending, within the ceiling plus one steps and state no crossing. The crossing with the level unmoved is one worked course.
findings.evidence: TurningInTime.lean:1438: "no step past a point of no return is stated"; :2961 rise_count_ends `12 < 7 + 6`. LineOnAStock.lean:1011 need_unmet.
findings.proposed_wording: Proved, with the growth given: the line comes to an unmet need, and the lock ends, within the ceiling plus one steps. That either is past the boundary before the level falls is one worked course.

findings.sentence: They are independent, so there are four cells, not three states.
findings.what_is_so: Independent only because the take is a free function of the way. Under the proposal's tie (the take a count that favouring raises), every lock needing a capped stock that nothing reads ends: locked-and-kept is empty. Courses: locked, running out, Three.lock_ends; locked, kept, the tail of Three.read_to_ten; not locked, kept, Three.unlocked_goes_on; not locked, running out, none found where there is a rule. Cells are states, not fates: a locked start below its boundary goes on if read in time.
findings.evidence: TurningInTime.lean:1440 locked_ends_rising, :1473 count_rises `(rise : ∀ a g, favours g → a < fA a g)`; :2501, :2728, :2906.
findings.proposed_wording: Separate questions, so four cells; three have a worked course. Independent only while the take does not follow the share. A cell says where a course is, not how it ends.

findings.sentence: Cancer is the lock on the wrong side of the boundary, or the lock with a take that grows.
findings.what_is_so: A definition proposed, not a reading: the map's cancer theorem has no lock, its meta-attractor no stock. It keeps closing on itself and using up. It leaves out that nothing of the level reaches how it selects (the README's "most dangerous property"; premise `un` of the lock-ends laws), that it needs what it uses up, and the whole it is favoured within.
findings.evidence: Founding.lean:166 ConfinedRise.ends: "Its selection within, and its drawing, do not enter". TurningInTime.lean:1446 `un`. Atlas closed-capture: `Unread`.
findings.proposed_wording: Cancer as four together: closed on itself; a take unmet or growing; nothing of the level reaching how it selects in time; needing what it uses up. No theorem has all four.

findings.sentence: "What is favoured draws more" then follows from descent; today it is a premise.
findings.what_is_so: Unrestricted, the space is a dictionary: it is already `pair`. Smallest restriction found: take and give add over members; giving rises with what is left, nothing from nothing; who leaves what reads the way only through counts, rising; needs do not rise along descent; for exactness, descent conserves take and give. A giving member then lowers the boundary by a law already there. The headline moves a premise: today's `rise` and `count` become share-as-a-count (as a ratio it fails) and the given offspring. Mutual support is no case of one level: takers lower, and the order of fates breaks.
findings.evidence: TurningInTime.lean:337 `def pair (after : W → Nat → W) (left : W → Nat → Nat)`; :1473. LineOnAStock.lean:1705 ShareRises. RegimeMargin.lean:783 root_mono; :3502 breaks_order.
findings.proposed_wording: With the share a count and favoured meaning leaving more, the favoured kind draws more: today's law, its premise moved into who leaves what. Nothing is derived yet.

findings.sentence: *What would count as nothing having changed, fixed now.* …
findings.what_is_so: The first passes by making a premise a definition (C1). The second is passed today by an exact law that changes with the giving alone and with the take alone: the weakest. The third passes by a dictionary unless the Lean gets shorter; the lock's two laws named to go are days old. The fourth: a start fixes its course, so a course condition is a start condition.
findings.evidence: RegimeMargin.lean:741; :3281 `ending … := decide (…)`.
findings.proposed_wording: Fixed now: one theorem, whose premises run no course, gives both fates of the worked case where the higher start ends; a named proof older than 12 November returns as its case; the Lean is shorter after.

findings.sentence: ## Attractors, transitions, paths: what is proved today
findings.what_is_so: The table gives thresholds in the state, regions without basins, and paths between different spaces. Two parameter transitions are proved, not said as such: the take against the greatest giving; the first reading's step against the point of no return. A full answer needs one named space; every start's fate; for each parameter the value at which a region appears or vanishes; one drawing, each arrow marked law, case or missing. "Generative" here means giving back only.
findings.evidence: RegimeMargin.lean:721; TurningInTime.lean:2289; 05-COLLECTIVES.md:365 "none a proved phase transition".
findings.proposed_wording: Not on this page yet: a transition as a parameter passing a value; every start's fate; one drawing.
